name: Default
shortDescription: Django forum with categories, private threads, polls, moderation tools and OAuth sign-in, backed by PostgreSQL, Redis and a Celery worker.

alerts.message: The first start creates the admin account from MISAGO_ADMIN_USERNAME, MISAGO_ADMIN_EMAIL and the generated MISAGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Set MISAGO_ADMIN_EMAIL to your own address before the first deploy, or change it from admin@example.com after signing in. The admin panel is at /admincp/.
Emails such as account activation and password resets are only written to the logs until SMTP is set: set MISAGO_EMAIL_PROVIDER to smtp, fill in the other MISAGO_EMAIL_* variables and redeploy.
HTTPS is required: session and CSRF cookies are marked Secure, so signing in fails on a plain HTTP domain.
